While our long-term objectives remain focused on value creation, growth, profitability, and deleveraging, we have been advancing our comprehensive review of the business, including the strategic review of the Consumer Beauty business, and expect to complete the review by the end of calendar 2026.

We currently estimate that, if Brent crude oil prices remain within the range of $90 to $100 per barrel due to the Middle East conflict, our operating results in fiscal 2027 could be impacted by an increase of approximately $25.0 to $30.0 in cost of goods sold.

The Gucci license exit will result in a decrease in net revenues and net income in fiscal 2028; we expect partial mitigation of the impact through stronger performance in our top core prestige fragrance brands, as well as debuts of Etro and Swarovski fragrances in the coming year.

We expect to consider any future resumption of dividends in line with that target while continuing to pursue our deleveraging agenda and implementing our strategic initiatives.
Any determination to pay dividends in the future will be at the discretion of our Board of Directors.
